data.heading: Interactive Technical Dashboards
data.subtitle: Leveraging native SVGs and Glassmorphic data blocks to visualize microservices metrics in real-time.
data.speakerNotes: Welcome everyone! Today we are showcasing the dynamic, low-latency static analytics block rendering.

data.heading: Bento Grid Dashboard Overview

items.title: Asymmetric Dashboard Performance
items.content: A high-fidelity layout representing cluster efficiency. Native SVG charts fit directly into custom glass cards to optimize visible screen real estate.

data.speakerNotes: Show students the Bento layout. Point out how the main card sets the theme and small cards show quick stats.

data.heading: Server Cluster Capacity & Idle Rates
data.speakerNotes: Explain the interactive bar chart. Point out that clicking on the legend items will hide/show datasets dynamically.

data.heading: Cloud Infrastructure Footprint
data.speakerNotes: Showcase the donut chart representing TB storage allocation. Hover segments to view interactive tooltips.

data.heading: Microservices Node Directory
data.speakerNotes: The table has full sorting. Click on Node Name or Load columns to sort, or type in the input box to instantly filter rows.

data.heading: Analytical Data Pipeline Architecture

nodes.label: 1. Event Ingestion
nodes.details: Real-time user event streams are captured via WebSocket gateways and piped straight into memory buffers.

nodes.label: 2. Stream Processing
nodes.details: High-performance streaming engine cleanses, maps schemas, and calculates rolling statistics.

nodes.label: 3. Analytical Warehouse
nodes.details: Aggregated time-series chunks are persisted inside highly optimized, queryable columns.

nodes.label: 4. Lecta Dashboard
nodes.details: The presentation layer renders the charts with millisecond latency, without external databases.

data.speakerNotes: Select nodes on the flowchart to deep-dive into each pipeline stage. A gorgeous visual sequence!

data.heading: Technical Dashboard Takeaways
items: Native SVGs provide high-performance chart animations without bulky heavy JS frameworks.
OKLCH color mapping scales cleanly across dark themes like Midnight without clipping.
Live search/filtering and sorting makes static tables feel premium and interactive.
Flowcharts keep presentation audiences engaged by enabling deep-dives on demand.
data.callToAction: Build highly interactive dashboards for your slides now!
data.speakerNotes: Conclude the dashboard visualization training. Invite questions from the audience.
